tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Find bounded public catalogue variants. Indexed stock and prices are snapshots (converted from USD like the storefront shows them); call get_product_options for fresh prices and stock before create_cart_link. This never confirms activation eligibility.

tools.name: get_product_options
tools.description: Read fresh product variants, exact edition/platform/region, stock and explicit currency prices. Activation is advisory and unknown stays unknown; checkout revalidates prices and stock.

tools.name: check_activation_country
tools.description: Check live advisory activation evidence for one exact variant and an explicit country. An incompatible variant remains purchasable under the storefront policy; unknown is never compatible.

tools.name: get_activation_guide
tools.description: Return the existing verified official activation destination for an exact variant, without reading or embedding any purchased code. Detailed product instructions remain on the product page; ambiguous products return unknown.

tools.name: create_cart_link
tools.description: Create a lootcodes.com link that opens the buyer's cart review with exact variants and quantities (1 to 5 each, up to 10 items) chosen from get_product_options. The buyer sees each item, confirms, then pays on the site; this tool adds nothing to any cart, reserves no stock and creates no order. Item

tools.name: get_store_information
tools.description: Read how LootCodes sells and delivers: what it sells, delivery, support contact and links to the terms, refund policy, privacy policy and FAQ.
